title: China-to-Finland Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: EMC — IEC 62920 and IEC 61000 Evidence for Finland PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: Finland PV inverter EMC expectations should be prepared on an IEC/EN basis because SFS (Finnish Standards Association) adopts IEC/CENELEC standards, and project specifications for grid-connected PV commonly reference IEC-family inverter evidence. The practical EMC package should include IEC 62920 for PV power conversion equipment and applicable IEC 61000-series evidence for emissions, immunity, harmonics, surge, voltage dips, and power quality. For Fingrid and distribution-network-operator connected projects, harmonic and conducted-emission evidence should be tied to the actual inverter model, rating, and configuration. Because Finland uses a 230/400 V, 50 Hz grid, EMC and harmonic results obtained only under China 220/380 V conditions should be reviewed for applicability before submission. Finnish or Swedish language instructions may also be required.
target_standards: IEC 62920 — Photovoltaic power generating systems — EMC requirements and test methods for power conversion equipment
IEC 61000 series — Electromagnetic compatibility test, immunity, harmonic, surge, voltage-dip, and power-quality standards as applicable to the inverter configuration
SFS standards adoption and project specification requirements where applicable (SFS adopts EN/IEC standards as SFS-EN or SFS-IEC)
Fingrid and distribution system operator requirements for power quality and harmonic performance
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter EMC evidence commonly relies on GB/T 37408-2021 and related domestic EMC test reports from CNAS-accredited laboratories. These reports can be useful engineering background but are not automatically equivalent to IEC 62920 or the IEC 61000-series evidence requested by a Finland project owner, SFS conformity route, Energiavirasto review, or Fingrid grid-connection process. China test conditions are normally aligned with the China 220/380 V, 50 Hz baseline, while Finland uses 230/400 V at the same frequency.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CNAS-accredited domestic EMC test reports under China standard scopes
rows.gap: Gap: China-only EMC certificates under GB/T 37408 do not automatically satisfy Finland IEC/EN-based project expectations. Exporters should obtain IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000-series reports for the specific model or family, confirm whether harmonics and conducted-emission results remain valid at 230/400 V, and provide surge, earthing, shielding, and enclosure documentation suitable for Finnish installations (including consideration of cold-climate condensation and thermal cycling effects on EMC shielding). Where Fingrid or the project owner specifies harmonic limits or power-quality measurements, test reports should be mapped clause-by-clause to that requirement.

mandatory_status.target: Project-specific and effectively mandatory where SFS, Fingrid, Energiavirasto, or project-owner documentation calls for IEC EMC and power-quality evidence
mandatory_status.cn: GB/T 37408 EMC evidence is a China domestic voluntary or certification-programme baseline and is not a Finland IEC/EN evidence substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat Finland PV inverter EMC as an IEC/EN evidence package, not a China GB/T certificate transfer. Prepare IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000-series reports for the exact inverter model, review harmonic and EMC applicability at Finland's 230/400 V 50 Hz grid voltage, and confirm any SFS, Fingrid, Energiavirasto, or project-owner EMC requirements before shipment. Finnish or Swedish language instructions may be required.

rows.requirement: Fingrid / Distribution Operator Grid-Connection Review — IEC 62116, IEC 61727, and 230/400 V 50 Hz Settings
rows.target_requirement: Grid-connected solar PV inverters in Finland should be treated as project-level grid-connection equipment subject to Fingrid technical review (for transmission-connected large installations) or relevant distribution system operator (DSO) review for smaller grid-connected systems, with Energiavirasto overseeing the electricity market. The practical IEC evidence package normally includes IEC 62116 anti-islanding and IEC 61727 utility-interface compliance, with firmware protection thresholds, reconnection delay, voltage windows, and frequency windows validated for Finland's 230/400 V, 50 Hz low-voltage grid. Finland uses the same 50 Hz frequency as China, but the nominal voltage differs: Finland is 230 V single-phase and 400 V three-phase, while China is 220/380 V under GB/T 156. Finnish conditions include extreme cold winters (down to -30°C or lower) which may affect inverter performance and derating profiles; commissioning files should document cold-climate performance.
target_standards: IEC 62116 — Utility-interconnected photovoltaic inverters — Test procedure of islanding prevention measures
IEC 61727 — Photovoltaic systems — Characteristics of the utility interface
Fingrid technical grid-connection requirements for the relevant installation
Energiavirasto electricity-sector approval or oversight requirements where applicable
Finland low-voltage grid context — 230 V single-phase / 400 V three-phase, 50 Hz
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter grid-connection evidence commonly includes GB/T 19964-2024 for PV power station connection, NB/T 32004 for grid-connected inverter technical specifications, GB/T 37408 for PV grid-connected inverter requirements, and domestic anti-islanding test results. These documents are built around China grid conditions and domestic acceptance procedures. China's low-voltage baseline is 220/380 V at 50 Hz, not Finland's 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Chinese grid certificates and factory firmware settings do not automatically transfer to Fingrid acceptance or Energiavirasto project review in Finland.
china_standards: GB/T 19964-2024 — 光伏发电站接入电力系统技术规定 (Technical Requirements for Connecting Photovoltaic Power Station to Power System)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
rows.gap: Gap: China GB/T and NB/T grid-connection evidence is not a substitute for Finland Fingrid/DSO project acceptance. Exporters should prepare IEC 62116 anti-islanding evidence, IEC 61727 utility-interface evidence, a Finland-specific settings file, and commissioning records for 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Do not describe Finland voltage as matching China: only the 50 Hz frequency matches, while nominal voltage differs from China's 220/380 V. For Finnish sites, include cold-climate (-30°C or lower) derating, anti-condensation heater provision, thermal cycling effects on ingress protection seals, and cold-start performance in the project file.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory in practice for grid-connected projects through Fingrid technical review (large installations) and DSO acceptance (smaller installations); Energiavirasto oversight applies to the Finnish electricity market
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese grid-connection evidence satisfies China domestic grid acceptance only and is not a Fingrid or Finnish DSO approval substitute; China 220/380 V evidence must be revalidated for Finland 230/400 V

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Chinese GB/T grid-connection documents do not automatically satisfy Finland Fingrid/DSO grid-connection review. Prepare IEC 62116 and IEC 61727 evidence, re-parameterise inverter firmware for Finland's 230/400 V at 50 Hz grid, and document cold-climate (-30°C or lower) derating and cold-start performance for Finnish installations. Verify current Fingrid, DSO, and Energiavirasto project requirements directly before shipment or commissioning.

rows.requirement: IEC 62109-1 / IEC 62109-2 Safety Evidence and Cold-Climate Derating for Finland PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: For Finland solar PV projects, inverter safety documentation should be prepared around IEC 62109-1 and IEC 62109-2 type-test evidence for the exact inverter model or family. SFS is the national standards body adopting IEC/EN standards, Energiavirasto oversees the energy sector, and Fingrid and DSOs control the practical grid-connection interface, so project submissions should include accredited IEC safety reports, installation manuals, ratings, nameplate data, protection-device coordination, earthing instructions, and environmental limits. Finland presents extreme cold-weather operating conditions (winter temperatures down to -30°C or colder in northern Finland), so safety files should specifically address low-temperature derating, cold-start performance, anti-condensation heater systems, thermal cycling effects on seals and components, and enclosure ingress protection under freeze-thaw cycles. Finnish or Swedish language safety documentation may be required.
target_standards: IEC 62109-1 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 1: General requirements
IEC 62109-2 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 2: Particular requirements for inverters
SFS standards adoption and conformity expectations where applicable (SFS adopts IEC/EN standards as SFS-EN or SFS-IEC)
Energiavirasto and Fingrid/DSO project documentation requirements for grid-connected solar PV equipment
Project environmental requirements for cold-climate (-30°C or lower), freeze-thaw cycling, condensation, ingress protection, and thermal derating
rows.china_equivalent: China safety documentation for PV grid-connected inverters commonly uses GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, domestic CQC or CGC voluntary certification, and CNAS-accredited laboratory reports. These documents are useful for supplier qualification but are not automatically accepted as IEC 62109-1/-2 evidence for Finland projects. Chinese safety reports may also be based on China-rated configurations, labels, manuals, surge protection, and 220/380 V assumptions, while Finland project files must reflect 230/400 V, 50 Hz installation conditions and cold-climate environmental exposure including freeze-thaw cycling.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CQC / CGC voluntary certification programmes for China domestic PV inverter safety and performance
rows.gap: Gap: A China-only GB/T 37408 or NB/T 32004 safety file does not automatically satisfy Finland IEC/EN safety expectations. Exporters should provide IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test reports for the supplied model or model family, confirm that labels and manuals match the Finland configuration (230/400 V, 50 Hz), document protection coordination and earthing, and add environmental evidence for cold-climate derating (minimum operating temperature, cold-start procedures, anti-condensation heater, freeze-thaw seal integrity, and ingress protection). Finnish or Swedish language manuals may be required. Any changes to enclosure, terminals, firmware settings, surge protection, or nameplate ratings for Finland can require updated safety documentation.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory in practice where SFS, Fingrid, Energiavirasto, DSO, EPC, lender, insurer, or project-owner documentation requires IEC 62109 safety evidence for grid-connected PV inverters
mandatory_status.cn: China GB/T, NB/T, CQC, or CGC safety evidence applies to China domestic or voluntary certification contexts and is not automatically transferable to Finland

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not rely on China GB/T or NB/T inverter safety files alone for Finland PV projects. Prepare IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test evidence for the exact model, align labels and manuals to Finland's 230/400 V 50 Hz configuration, and document cold-climate derating (-30°C or lower), anti-condensation, freeze-thaw ingress protection, and cold-start controls. Finnish or Swedish language documentation may be required. Confirm current SFS, Fingrid, Energiavirasto, Tukes, and project-owner safety requirements before shipment.
